contract: Provide read_text(path) and write_text(path,text,*,append=False), UTF-8 text, str or Path paths. Read the whole file. Write overwrites by default or appends on append=True; create missing files, but do not create parent directories. Missing reads raise FileNotFoundError.

Provide read_text(path) and write_text(path,text,*,append=False), UTF-16 (not UTF-8) text, str or Path paths. Read the whole file. Overwrite by default, append when requested. Do not create parent directories. Missing reads raise FileNotFoundError.
